plugin.name: Weather Catgirl
plugin.description: Let your catgirl check the weather: current conditions, hourly rain chance, a 3-7 day forecast, plus what to wear and whether to take an umbrella. The full brief is posted straight into chat by the plugin so nothing gets trimmed. Set your city once and she will brief you every morning — with the occasional snarky translated-novel easter egg. Powered by Open-Meteo, no API key required

entry.get_weather.description: Get the current weather and what to wear / whether to take an umbrella
entry.get_hourly.name: Hourly weather
entry.get_hourly.description: Temperature and rain chance for the next few hours
entry.set_home_city.name: Set home city
entry.set_home_city.description: Remember a city for weather lookups and the daily brief
entry.push_daily_brief.name: Push weather brief now
entry.push_daily_brief.description: Immediately generate and push today's weather brief
